title: How I cope with stress
subtitle: Resources in difficult moments
description: Reflect on how often you notice stress early, pause, and find a manageable next step.
algorithm: Answer for your recent everyday life, not an ideal version of yourself.
The result is a reflection prompt, not a diagnosis. You can try a related practice afterward.
comment: An original self-reflection check-in. It is not a standardized or clinical test.
questions: I notice early signs of stress.
After a difficult moment, I can pause before reacting.
I choose a next step that I can influence.
I know at least one way to settle my body.
When needed, I can ask for support.
I can break a problem into a smaller step.
